description: Timeline primitives accepted by video/engine.js. Every frame is a pure function of t. tests/engine-preview.spec.cjs checks this file against the running engine (window.__enginePrimitives).

scene_attributes.data-start: scene start, seconds from the start of the film
scene_attributes.data-trans: "cut" switches without the wipe; any other value or none wipes in from the left

page.wipe_edge: an optional child .edge of a scene is moved along the wipe
page.render_hooks: window.__renderHooks: functions called with t after each render
page.ready: window.__ready: a promise the recorder awaits before recording

element_attributes.data-fx: one primitive id from primitives below
element_attributes.data-at: start, seconds after the scene starts (default 0)
element_attributes.data-dur: duration in seconds (default: the primitive's default_duration_sec)
element_attributes.data-out: fade out over 0.3 s from this time, seconds after the scene starts
element_attributes.data-on: adds class "on" from this time, seconds after the scene starts
element_attributes.data-base: a transform kept after the primitive's own transform

sound_attributes.data-sfx-at: cue time, seconds after the scene starts (default: data-at)

automatic_cues.name: whoosh
automatic_cues.when: the start of every scene after the first, also with data-trans="cut"

automatic_cues.name: type
automatic_cues.when: data-sfx="type" repeats every 0.07 s for the element's data-dur

no_scale_rule: a primitive with scales=true, on an element that holds a canvas, a video or a [data-demo] tile, slides up 40 px instead of scaling

timing.in: animates over data-dur from data-at, then holds its end state
timing.pass: plays over data-dur from data-at and leaves the element as it was before
timing.continuous: keeps moving for the whole scene

primitives.behavior: fades in while rising 48 px
fades in while dropping 48 px
fades in from 70 px to the left
fades in from 70 px to the right
fades in
fades in while settling from 112 % to 100 %
scales up from 60 % with an overshoot
grows horizontally from its transform origin
draws a background highlight band across the element
types the element's text, with class "caret" while typing
counts from 0 to data-to, formatted with en-US separators
moves the element's left/top from one point to another
expands from 40 % to 170 % while fading out
splits the text into characters that pop in one after another
lands from 190 % scale
slowly scales up over data-dur (a slow push; set a long data-dur)
rotates from the scene start
pans the background image from the scene start
shakes with a decaying amplitude
breathes in scale from data-at
bobs up and down from the scene start
flashes to full opacity and fades out
hidden before data-at, then switches between full and 35 % opacity every 0.4 s
moves an SVG textPath's startOffset
slides in sideways with horizontal motion blur
a skewed highlight crosses the element
expands from 15 % to 405 % and fades out
sharpens from a blur while fading in
moves a background band down the element
